title: Docker cleanup is not armed while container startup is in flight
reasoning: The cleanup try/finally begins only after docker run has returned successfully. If startup times out or raises after the Docker daemon accepted the request, _checked raises before the cleanup block is entered, potentially leaving the named container running indefinitely. The exact randomized container name is already known and could be used for best-effort cleanup.
reproduction: Provide a run stub that raises subprocess.TimeoutExpired for docker run and records later calls. _provision_postgres_test_environment raises without issuing docker rm -f for the generated container name.
recommendation: Arm cleanup before invoking docker run. Track whether startup was attempted and perform best-effort removal by the exact generated name for timeout, launch-error, nonzero-exit, and malformed-output paths while preserving the primary exception.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The malformed-ID test covers cleanup after docker run returns success; it does not exercise timeout, exception, or nonzero startup paths.
suggestedRegressionTest: Make docker run raise TimeoutExpired after recording its --name argument and assert that docker rm -f is attempted for that exact name.
minimumFixScope: Restructure _provision_postgres_test_environment startup cleanup and extend tests/test_validation_services.py.
